description: List every ERC-8183 escrow job one wallet sells or buys on BNB Chain, with the next step and deadline of each. Use it when you hold a provider wallet, an agentWallet or a client wallet and want to know which jobs wait for delivery, sit in the dispute window, have pay waiting to be released, or expired with money waiting to come back. Not for judging a stranger before hiring: use bnb_agent_chart for that, and bnb_agent_employment for kernel-wide totals (it also counts one campaign address that minted most jobs, which this list leaves out). Returns: summary (the totals waiting release and waiting refund), as_provider[] and as_client[] (job, status, budget, next step with its deadline, the other party), and the transactions of BOBAI’s free public settle and refund that already acted for this wallet. Read-only, free, no key. Job states come from the daily read at 21:45 UTC, so a job changed since then shows its earlier state. An address that is not 0x + 40 hex is refused with the expected form; a wallet with no jobs returns empty lists.

address.description: the wallet: 0x + 40 hex (a provider, an agentWallet, or a client)
